admin.roles.builtin.admin.defaultMessage: 内置角色，拥有所有权限。只能更改其徽章，且无法删除。
admin.roles.builtin.admin.description: Note on the built-in admin role on its page.

admin.roles.builtin.moderator.defaultMessage: 内置角色。可以更改其位置和权限，但无法删除。
admin.roles.builtin.moderator.description: Note on the built-in moderator role on its page.

admin.roles.cancel.description: Button that closes the confirmation of deleting a role without deleting it.

admin.roles.category.moderation.description: Label of the group of moderation permissions, and the term of them in the list of roles.

admin.roles.category.server.description: Label of the group of server administration permissions, and the term of them in the list of roles.

admin.roles.category.member.description: Label of the group of member permissions (features of the user's side, such as reading the finances), and the term of them in the list of roles.

admin.roles.created.defaultMessage: 已创建角色 {role}，审计日志已记录。
admin.roles.created.description: Result after creating a role. {role} is its key (isolated).

admin.roles.delete.description: Button that deletes a role (and the confirmation's button).

admin.roles.delete.description.defaultMessage: 此操作无法撤销。有人持有的角色无法删除：请先从他们那里撤销该角色。
admin.roles.delete.description.description: Body of the confirmation of deleting a role.

admin.roles.delete.title.description: Title of the confirmation of deleting a role. {role} is its key (isolated).

admin.roles.delete_failed.description: Error in the confirmation when deleting a role failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.

admin.roles.deleted.defaultMessage: 已删除角色 {role}，审计日志已记录。
admin.roles.deleted.description: Result after deleting a role. {role} is its key (isolated).

admin.roles.failed.outranked.defaultMessage: 此角色现在高于你的最高角色，因此你无法更改它。
admin.roles.failed.outranked.description: Error when the server refused a change of a role above the viewer's highest role (their roles changed since the page loaded).

admin.roles.key.description: Label of the field of a new role's key, its name.

admin.roles.key.description.defaultMessage: 最多 {max} 个小写字母、数字、下划线或连字符，不能为“new”。之后无法更改。
admin.roles.key.description.description: Description of the key field. {max} is the length limit.

admin.roles.key.invalid.defaultMessage: 请输入最多 {max} 个小写字母、数字、下划线或连字符。
admin.roles.key.invalid.description: Error of the key field when the key is empty or has other characters. {max} is the length limit.

admin.roles.key.reserved.defaultMessage: “new”不能用作角色键。请选择其他键。
admin.roles.key.reserved.description: Error of the key field when the key is "new", which the address of the page that creates a role uses.

admin.roles.list.title.description: Caption of the table of roles, highest position first.

admin.roles.missing_permissions.defaultMessage: 你的角色未授予的权限：{permissions}
admin.roles.missing_permissions.description: Error under the permissions of a role that the server refused. {permissions} lists the permissions (identifiers, isolated).

admin.roles.new.accounts.description: Link from the roles screen to the account search, where a role is granted.

admin.roles.new.description.defaultMessage: 新角色没有任何持有者。请在账号的管理页面授予该角色。
admin.roles.new.description.description: Text above the form that creates a role: how a role is granted. A link to the accounts follows.

admin.roles.new.no_role.defaultMessage: 你没有任何角色，因此无法创建角色。
admin.roles.new.no_role.description: Text instead of the form when the viewer holds no role (they may create none).

admin.roles.new.title.description: Title of the page that creates a role, and the link to it from the list of roles.

admin.roles.outranked.defaultMessage: 高于你的最高角色 {role}，因此你无法更改。
admin.roles.outranked.description: Note on the page of a role above the viewer's highest role. {role} is the viewer's highest role (isolated).

admin.roles.permission.manage_accounts.description: Name of the permission manage_accounts: the accounts and their moderation actions, registrations, sign-up blocks, and appeals.

admin.roles.permission.manage_announceme.description: Name of the permission manage_announcements: the server's announcements to every local user.

admin.roles.permission.manage_finance.description: Name of the permission manage_finance: the instance's costs, their totals, and the imports of the cloud providers' usage charges.

admin.roles.permission.view_finance.description: Name of the permission view_finance: reading the totals of the instance's costs on the finances page, without recording or changing them.

admin.roles.permission.create_custom_emo.description: Name of the permission create_custom_emojis: requesting new custom emoji, which an administrator approves, and changing and deleting the ones the user made.

admin.roles.permission.start_voice_rooms.description: Name of the permission start_voice_rooms: opening voice chat rooms and hosting them, while the server lets only the holders of this permission open them.

admin.roles.permission.create_invites.description: Name of the permission create_invites: creating, listing, and revoking invites of one's own, while the server lets only the holders of this permission create them.

admin.roles.permission.keep_posts_longer.description: Name of the permission keep_posts_longer: keeping one's own posts past the server's maximum of the automatic deletion of old posts, and turning that deletion off.

admin.roles.permission.manage_errors.description: Name of the permission manage_errors: the groups of the errors that the server and the web client report, resolving and muting them, and their notifications and webhook events.

admin.roles.permission.manage_login_prov.description: Name of the permission manage_login_providers: setting up, changing, disabling, and deleting the external identity providers (OpenID Connect, GitHub, Mastodon) that users sign in and sign up with.

admin.roles.permission.manage_oauth_apps.description: Name of the permission manage_oauth_apps: all the OAuth clients, disabling them, and denying the hosts of client metadata documents.

admin.roles.permission.manage_service_cl.description: Name of the permission manage_service_closure: announcing the closure of the service, changing its dates, withdrawing it, and closing the server.

admin.roles.permission.manage_supporters.description: Name of the permission manage_supporters: the supporter program, its plans, and their subscriptions.

admin.roles.permission.manage_custom_emo.description: Name of the permission manage_custom_emojis: the custom emoji.

admin.roles.permission.manage_domains.description: Name of the permission manage_domains: the moderation actions on domains and the health of remote servers.

admin.roles.permission.manage_invites.description: Name of the permission manage_invites: the invites.

admin.roles.permission.manage_jobs.description: Name of the permission manage_jobs: the dead jobs of the job queue.

admin.roles.permission.manage_reports.description: Name of the permission manage_reports: handling reports.

admin.roles.permission.manage_roles.description: Name of the permission manage_roles: the roles and granting them.

admin.roles.permission.manage_rules.description: Name of the permission manage_rules: the instance rules.

admin.roles.permission.manage_settings.description: Name of the permission manage_settings: the instance's settings, theme, terms, and privacy policy.

admin.roles.permission.manage_login_reco.description: Name of the permission manage_login_recovery: recovering a user's sign-in, by removing their two-factor authentication or issuing a password reset link.

admin.roles.permission.manage_webhooks.description: Name of the permission manage_webhooks: the webhooks.

admin.roles.permission.view_audit.description: Name of the permission view_audit: reading the audit log.

admin.roles.permissions.description.defaultMessage: 选择此角色授予的权限。你只能授予或移除你自己的角色所拥有的权限。
admin.roles.permissions.description.description: Text above the groups of permission checkboxes of a role.

admin.roles.permissions.none.description: Value of a permission area in the list of roles when the role has none of its permissions.

admin.roles.permissions.separator.description: Separator between the names of permissions in a list of them.

admin.roles.position.description: Label of the field of a role's position (its rank), and the term of the position in the list.

admin.roles.position.description.defaultMessage: 0 到 {max} 之间的整数。位置高的角色优先于位置低的角色；你只能管理不高于你自己最高角色的角色。
admin.roles.position.description.description: Description of the position field. {max} is the highest position the viewer may give.

admin.roles.position.invalid.defaultMessage: 请输入 0 到 {max} 之间的整数。
admin.roles.position.invalid.description: Error of the position field when it is not a whole number in range. {max} is the highest position the viewer may give.

admin.roles.save.description: Button that saves a role's position, permissions and badge on its page.

admin.roles.save_failed.description: Error of the role form or dialog. {reason} is the server's explanation.

admin.roles.summary.defaultMessage: 创建角色，并选择其位置和权限。
admin.roles.summary.description: Description of the roles screen in the administration menu of the settings.

admin.roles.title.description: Title of the roles screen, in the administration menu and as its heading.

admin.roles.updated.defaultMessage: 已更改角色 {role}。持有者将从下一次请求起获得此更改。审计日志已记录。
admin.roles.updated.description: Result after changing a role. {role} is its key (isolated).

admin.roles.badge.none.description: The value of the badge term when a role has no badge.

admin.roles.description.defaultMessage: 每个角色会将其权限授予持有它的账号。位置高的角色优先于位置低的角色。
